search_text: published ZDI-21-279 ZDI-CAN-11094 Google Android fts_driver_test_write Heap-based Buffer Overflow Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2021-03-12 CVE-2021-0457 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-0457 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Google'] ['Android'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Google Android. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the fts_driver_test_write function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute code in the context of the kernel. Google has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
